name: AAPerfSentinel
description: Suite-wide performance profiler. Attributes main-thread work (timers, rAF, observers, Flux, IndexedDB callbacks, DOM listeners) to individual plugins with per-function breakdowns, >50ms block counts, and renderer CPU. Writes an overwriting report file. Named 'AA' so BetterDiscord loads it before every other plugin — instrumentation must install first.
author: Matthew Thompson
